about: The flake register: GameTests known to pass and fail at one clean commit, each with its issue. A release run leaves them out (gate.py run --flake-register) and says so in its record; the nightly runs them and reports a failure as known-flaky. Add a row only after `gate.py report` shows the test passed AND failed at one gate tree; remove it in the pull request that fixes it. docs/GATE_B.md, 'The flake register'.
